ops.body: - [loop] The mention picker still runs under the keyboard. `MomentPicker` (`components/threads/MomentPicker.tsx`, `paddingBottom: insets.bottom + 12`) keeps no room for the keys in its three hosts: the composer's @ (a Modal), the note page's @ (`NotePage.tsx`) and the viewer's "Notes that mention it" (`CaptureView.tsx`); with its search focused on an iPhone the last rows and Show more sit under the keys. Fix: what `AddToThread` does since fix picker-keyboard (`lineLift(keyboard, below)` plus `accessoryRoom` at its foot, `below` measured at rest and again after a turn). Test: `fix mention-keyboard: with the keyboard up, Mention a moment ends above the keys` (e2e, the `visualViewport` stub) (fix picker-keyboard, auditor F1, Nov 18, medium, a second issue)

- [loop] The journal's open line still rises for a keyboard another field raised. `OpenLine` lifts by `lineLift(keyboard, below)` for any keyboard (`OpenLine.tsx`, `lift`), so with Add to a thread's search focused it rides up behind the picker's dimmed ground (a seam shows beside the card), and `onHeight` grows the page's `footPad` by the lift, so the journal behind scrolls to its end and back. Since fix picker-keyboard the picker is drawn over it, so nothing covers a control. Fix: lift only while the line's own field, the composer or a capture of its own has the keyboard. Test: `fix picker-keyboard audit 3: a keyboard raised by another field leaves the open line at rest` (fix picker-keyboard, auditor F3, Nov 18, low)

- [loop] Add to a thread's dimmed ground covers only Memories' own view: the section chips above it (Memories, Walks, Days, Map, Media) and the tab bar stay bright and tappable while the picker is up (HIG tab bars: "a modal view covers the tab bar"; one modal at a time, S2). Older than fix picker-keyboard. Fix: dim and block the whole screen, or hide the chips while it is up. (fix picker-keyboard, ux-reviewer U3, Nov 18, low)

argv: keyboard does not hide the rows
ops.body: - [ ] **Do:** on iOS and Android, in Chronicle's Memories, tap an entry's Thread, then A new thread, and tap the search field; then do the same from a moment's viewer (More, Add to a thread). **Expect:** the journal's toolbar ("What’s on your mind?") stays behind the picker's dimmed ground, never over the card, and the card's foot ends above the keyboard (Memories: by what the keyboard covers above the tab bar), so its last row can be scrolled into view and tapped; at rest the card ends above the home indicator as before. (fix picker-keyboard)
